item.title: About
item.description: Hello! I’m Sam Albury and this is my site. Currently, (Summer 2026) I am in my senior year studying physics at UMass Amherst. Previously, I attended New College of Florida and Hampshire College, but had to leave both due to reasons beyond my control. For the past year and a half, I’ve worked for professors Andrea Pocar and Krishna Kumar on their nEXO research and development work. Last summer, I primarily worked on improvements to the signal path of Kumar’s xenon time projection chamber.This summer, I am heading Pocar’s investigation into the reflectance of magnesium fluoride coated aluminum in liquid xenon. In addition, I’ve been helping develop and document PocarLab’s wrapper for the Chroma optical simulation tool.

item.title: Grey literature and where to find it
item.description: Did you know that almost every detail about the design and operation of a nuclear power plant is online? You can download it, for free, legally, from the Nuclear Regulatory Comission. Dont belive me? Have a look: NRC ADAMS Search. This is just one example of “Grey Literature”, defined as government, academic, or industry documents which are not published by a commercial publisher.
